insight: Hybrid engine can tap your logged-in ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini web sessions instead of a paid API key, then automate actions on the page.
name: HARPA AI
tagline: AI browser agent for Chrome that automates web tasks.
description: A browser extension that fuses large language models with on-page web automation, letting an AI agent read, understand, and act on web pages — navigating, extracting data, filling forms, and monitoring sites for changes. It connects to multiple AI providers and ships 100+ preset commands for research, SEO, and writing. Available for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, and Opera.

modelSupport.notes: Use the providers' web UIs via your logged-in sessions or bring your own API keys.

edge: Pairs multi-provider chat with real scheduled browser automation and page-change monitoring, processed locally.
pros: Real web automation, not just chat
